new_bio: SUCHI is a DJ and producer who was born in Oslo and raised in London. Her sets draw on house, percussion, bass, breaks and techno. Mixmag listed her among its top 25 artists to watch in 2022. In 2025 she launched her label Ikke Sant, whose first release is the three-track Sub Cut EP. She has played Fabric, Phonox, Warehouse Project, Glastonbury, Sonar, ADE and Magnetic Fields, and played Boiler Room India in Bangalore and Hyderabad in 2022.
notes: Mixmag/DJ Mag sentence: the Mixmag 2022 top 25 list names SUCHI (entry 23) and does NOT name Nikki Nair. The DJ Mag 2022 artists-to-watch list names neither. The '12 artists you need to listen to in 2022' DJ Mag piece could not be found; its only source is SUCHI's ADE agency bio, so it is dropped for both artists. The RA biography is probably artist-supplied; I kept the six named supporters and the venue list from it but dropped Jon Hopkins, which no independent page confirms. Param may prefer to drop the supporter names too. Ikke Sant translation in the stored bio differs from DJ Mag's wording, so I left it out.

new_bio: Nikki Nair is a Tennessee-born, Atlanta-based producer and DJ whose music mixes US Southeast bass with UK and other influences. He launched his label n goes to infinity in February 2022. In 2023 he made the mini-album Set the Roof with Hudson Mohawke, whose music he has followed since 2010. Crack Magazine included him in its Signing Off series on the artists who defined 2023.
notes: The Mixmag and DJ Mag sentence in this bio was copied from SUCHI's: Mixmag's 2022 list names SUCHI, not Nikki Nair. Unsound's page says DJ Mag named him 'breakthrough North American producer of the year' in 2022; I could not open a DJ Mag page confirming it, so it is not included. Check djmag.com for that if wanted. Tennessee-born comes from Crack; it replaces the unsupported Knoxville detail.

new_bio: Indo Warehouse is a record label and event series founded in 2022 by Kunal Merchant and Kahani (Armaan Gupta). They coined the term Indo House for their mix of South Asian elements with house and techno. Their first party was a 200-person night on New York's Lower East Side in February 2022, and they have since played across Europe, Asia and the Middle East, including Hï Ibiza and F1 Singapore. In 2025 they were the first South Asian electronic collective to play Coachella, with more than 25 performers on stage in weekend one.
notes: F1 Singapore is supported only by the title of a Nylon Singapore search result (a preview saying they will play F1's Sunset Stage); the page itself was not opened, so confirm the date if it matters. 'Middle East' rests on one Homegrown line.

new_bio: Prismer is Rohan Kale, a New Delhi producer and DJ whose music runs across techno, jungle, drum and bass, dubstep, breakbeat and house. His early releases came out on Boxout.FM, Reel Long Overdub and Tokyo Hell. He has played alongside DJ Stingray, Pangaea, Ivy Lab and Rider Shafique, and has played Magnetic Fields and Grasslands in Nepal. He was on the bill for The Warehouse Project India in October 2025. He started the Delhi party series Mixed Feelings, which he describes as a safe space.

The Warehouse Project line is based on a pre-event preview. Mixed Feelings 'safe space' wording attributed to Goethe-Institut's Zeitgeister piece.
